newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PRESS DIGEST - SOUTH AFRICA - JULY 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - SOUTH AFRICA - JULY 10.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the South African press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- South African markets followed the gold price weaker on Wednesday, with the ailing metal losing $2.20 to close at $319.75 in London.

- Transport Minister Mac Maharaj has accepted wide-ranging recommendations which could result in an increase in the fuel levy to raise income to restrict the growing shortfall in the Road Accident Fund.

- National Sorghum Breweries executive chairman Mohale Mahanyele was forced to step down on Wednesday amid allegations of misappropriation of funds and conflict with India's United Breweries , which has a 30 percent stake in NSB.
- Housing Minister Sankie Mthembi-Mahanyele said she was aware of operational problems plaguing the low-cost housing programme, and that steps were being taken to rectify them.
- New foreign direct investment in South Africa more than tripled to $2.87 billion in the year to end-April compared with the previous year, the Investor Responsibility Research Centre said.
- Labour Minister Tito Mboweni warned labour and business that if consensus was not reached on the Basic Conditions of Employment Bill it would not be presented in parliament this year.
